```{r}
library(worldfootballR)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

```

```{r}
players2 <- read_excel("~/Desktop/stat/stat_proj_dt1.xlsx")%>%
  mutate(
    PlayerNameClean = tolower(str_squish(Player))
  )

```

```{r}
years_21_23 <- 2021:2023
countries_5  <- c("England", "Spain", "France", "Germany", "Italy")


test_one <- tm_player_market_values(
  country_name = "Spain",
  start_year   = 2021
)

head(test_one)
```


```{r}
mv_5_21_23_raw <- map_dfr(
  years_21_23,
  ~ tm_player_market_values(
      country_name = countries_5,
      start_year   = .x
    ) %>%
      mutate(SeasonStart = .x)   # 记录年份：2021/2022/2023
)

```

```{r}
mv_5_21_23_clean <- mv_5_21_23_raw %>%
  mutate(
    PlayerNameClean = tolower(str_squish(player_name))
  ) %>%
  select(
    PlayerNameClean,
    SeasonStart,                             # 2021, 2022, 2023
    MarketValue = player_market_value_euro,  # 身价（欧元）
    Club        = squad,
    League      = comp_name
  )
```

```{r}
mv_5_21_23_wide <- mv_5_21_23_clean %>%
  group_by(PlayerNameClean, SeasonStart) %>%
  summarise(
    MarketValue = max(MarketValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from   = SeasonStart,      # 2021 / 2022 / 2023 变成列名
    values_from  = MarketValue,      # 列里的值是当年的身价
    names_prefix = "MV_"             # MV_2021, MV_2022, MV_2023
  )

head(mv_5_21_23_wide)
```

```{r}
players2_with_values <- players2 %>%
  left_join(mv_5_21_23_wide, by = "PlayerNameClean")
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(players2_with_values, "players2_MV_2021_2023.xlsx")
```
